name: Serranópolis do Iguaçu (Brazil)
description: Vertical triband of green, yellow and green, charged at the centre with a brown ring reading SERRANÓPOLIS DO IGUAÇU around a white disc with two yellow stars, from which four yellow and green points and four white points radiate.
history: Serranópolis do Iguaçu is a municipality in the state of Paraná, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 23 November 1998 (designed by Cristiane Lângaro, winner of a public contest opened by Order No. 14 of 11 March 1997, and prescribed with the arms by Municipal Law No. 50 of 23 November 1998, according to Flags of the World).
